personal.bio2: My experience spans frontend development, backend services, database design, and API integration. During my internship at Cabitas I worked directly on production systems — contributing to database architecture, maintaining application workflows, and collaborating in a real engineering team. I bring both a builder's instinct and an engineer's eye for quality to everything I ship.
personal.bio3: Beyond core development, I also take on digital and visual work — landing pages, branding, and catalogs. Whether a client needs a web platform, a mobile product, or a complete online presence, I handle the project end-to-end: one person, full ownership, no handoffs.

special-education-saas.title: Special Education Management System
special-education-saas.description: A comprehensive SaaS management platform for special education centers, covering students, guardians, teachers, sessions, payments, payroll, reporting, calendar management and Excel imports.
special-education-saas.longDescription: I'm building a comprehensive SaaS platform for special education centers that unifies student and guardian records, teacher management, session scheduling, and payment/installment tracking into a single panel. The system brings together daily, weekly and monthly calendar views, teacher payroll, a daily cash register, financial and operational reporting, and an Excel data import wizard. Role-based dashboards let admins, teachers and office staff work within screens tailored to their permissions. A multi-tenant SaaS architecture is planned for a future phase.
special-education-saas.problem: Special education centers typically manage students, guardians, teachers, sessions, payments and reporting through scattered spreadsheets and disconnected tools, increasing error risk and operational overhead.
special-education-saas.solution: I'm building an end-to-end management system that unifies these processes into a single SaaS panel with role-based access, automatic scheduling conflict checks and financial reporting.

workify-ai.title: Workify AI – AI-Powered Task Management
workify-ai.description: An AI-powered productivity and task management application with authentication, workspaces, backend services and third-party AI integrations.
workify-ai.longDescription: Contributed to the development of an AI-assisted productivity platform designed to streamline task and workspace management. Built and integrated backend services, implemented authentication flows, and connected third-party APIs. Validated API responses and ensured system reliability throughout development — combining engineering with a quality-first mindset.
workify-ai.problem: Teams' task and workspace management is often split across disconnected tools, missing AI-powered automation.
workify-ai.solution: I built a prototype that unifies authentication, workspaces and task management in a single app, boosting productivity with third-party AI APIs.

easy-home-rent.title: Easy Home Rent – Rental Platform
easy-home-rent.description: A full-stack rental platform with authentication, property listings, search, filtering and CRUD operations.
easy-home-rent.longDescription: Designed and developed a web application for house rental management as a university project. Implemented user registration and authentication, property listing and search features, and complete CRUD operations for managing rental data. Designed application flows end-to-end and validated all major features during development to ensure functional correctness.
easy-home-rent.problem: There was a need for a simple platform to connect renters and listers with search and filtering capabilities.
easy-home-rent.solution: I built an end-to-end web application with authentication, listing management, search/filtering, and full CRUD operations.

myfitly.title: MyFitly – Fitness & Diet App
myfitly.description: A cross-platform fitness and nutrition application featuring workout tracking, meal management and user progress monitoring.
myfitly.longDescription: Built a mobile application for fitness and nutrition tracking as part of a hands-on mobile development course. Implemented core features including exercise logging, daily diet tracking, and progress visualization. Validated application behavior throughout development to ensure a reliable and consistent user experience across iOS and Android.
myfitly.problem: Users needed to track workouts and nutrition from a single, platform-independent mobile app.
myfitly.solution: I built a cross-platform mobile app with React Native and Expo, featuring workout logging, nutrition tracking and progress indicators.

firefighting-drone.title: Firefighting Drone – Graduation Project
firefighting-drone.description: A graduation project focused on the software logic, remote-control mechanisms, sensor integrations and embedded systems of a high-capacity firefighting drone.
firefighting-drone.longDescription: Designed and implemented the full software system for an autonomous firefighting drone as the university graduation project. Focused on system architecture, control flow logic, and sensor integration to enable reliable autonomous operation. Conducted functional validation at each development stage to ensure system safety and correctness under simulated conditions.
firefighting-drone.problem: Forest fires needed a fast-response system with high payload capacity and remote-control capability, but lacked a dedicated software foundation.
firefighting-drone.solution: I designed and built the software logic covering remote-control mechanisms, sensor integrations and embedded system components as my graduation project.

iot-smart-monitoring.title: IoT Smart Monitoring Systems
iot-smart-monitoring.description: An IoT-based environmental monitoring system that collects real-time sensor data, processes measurements and supports automated control logic.
iot-smart-monitoring.longDescription: Developed a series of IoT projects using hardware sensors for environmental data collection and monitoring. Implemented data pipelines and basic automated control logic, then verified sensor accuracy and system behavior throughout development and testing. Gained practical experience with embedded systems and real-time data flows.
iot-smart-monitoring.problem: Environmental data needed to be collected and monitored in real time, with automated control mechanisms.
iot-smart-monitoring.solution: I built an IoT system that collects real-time sensor data, processes it, and applies automated control logic.

personal-portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio Website
personal-portfolio.description: A modern and responsive portfolio website built to showcase my software, mobile, AI, SaaS and embedded systems projects.
personal-portfolio.longDescription: I designed and built this portfolio site to showcase the projects I've developed across software, mobile, AI, SaaS and embedded systems under one roof. Using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, I created a dark, purple-toned, modern interface with multi-language support, animated sections and a fully responsive layout that stays consistent across desktop, tablet and mobile.
personal-portfolio.problem: I needed a single, modern and performant place to showcase my software, mobile, AI, SaaS and embedded systems projects.
personal-portfolio.solution: I'm building a modern, responsive and performance-focused personal portfolio site with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.

qr-reader.title: PDF QR Reader
qr-reader.description: A Python automation tool that reads QR codes from PDF documents, extracts UUID values and exports the results to Excel.
qr-reader.longDescription: I built a Python automation tool that scans and reads QR codes embedded in PDF documents, extracting the decoded UUID values into a structured Excel file. The tool processes multiple documents in batch, removing the need for manual data entry.
qr-reader.problem: Manually reading QR codes from large batches of PDF documents and transferring them to Excel was slow and error-prone.
qr-reader.solution: I built a Python automation tool that automatically reads QR codes from PDF documents, extracts UUID values, and exports the results to Excel.
